name: interrupt-without-a-session-reports-nothing-to-interrupt
description: Interrupt in built-in mode with no session running says there is nothing to interrupt, with an error entry, and asks the harness for nothing.
reason: The Claude adapter silently drops an interrupt when no process is running. Confirming 'Interrupt sent.' would tell the person something happened when nothing did.
source: AppState.interruptClaude (comment: 'ClaudeService.interrupt() silently no-ops without a live process')

script.reason: No session has been started yet.

transcript.text: No Claude session is running — nothing to interrupt.
